notes:
# v1.3.18 — professional legal documents, sign-in animation, account sync on sign-in

- New: the Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy are rewritten as full,
  professional documents. They now render as a properly formatted document in
  the legal modal — headings, lists and emphasis — instead of showing raw
  markdown markers like `##` and `**`.
- New: the sign-in gate animates in with a subtle, App Store-style sequence. The
  card, fields, consent rows and buttons fade and rise in turn, inputs get a
  focus ring, buttons press in, and error messages shake. All of the motion
  honours the system "reduce motion" setting.
- Fixed: signing in or creating an account now syncs the account with the
  reading progress already on the device. Previously a fresh account could show
  0 bookmarks, 0 history and level 0 even though the device held a full library;
  the app now pushes the local progress up and refreshes your level right after
  sign-in, with a toast reporting the synced counts.
